newsitem.title: USA: UroHealth sells $110 mln in high-yield debt.
newsitem.headline: UroHealth sells $110 mln in high-yield debt.

text.p: The following 144a private placement of $110 million in high-yield bonds from UroHealth Systems Inc was priced on Thursday via Bear Stearns & Co Inc, according to market sources.
UroHealth develops and markets medical and lab products.
TYPE SR SUB NOTES ISS PRICE 100 FIRST PAY DATE 10/1/97
LAST MOODY'S B3 YIELD 12.50 PCT PAY FREQ SEMI-ANNUAL
LAST S&P B-MINUS SPREAD 566 BPS CALLABLE NON-CALLABLE FOR
NOTES: The deal includes a three-year equity call for 35 percent of the issue at 112.
The bonds are being issued as units that also include warrants to purchase two percent of the company or four percent if 12-month EBITDA falls below $32.5 million by March 31, 1998.
The warrants will be exercisable on June 30, 1998 at a strike price of $9.50.
